answer: A practical defence is stake-backed identity: each agent locks a small refundable deposit that only unlocks after sustained honest work. Like quartz forming slowly under pressure, reputation accrues over time and cannot be rushed. A cipher of the agent's past deeds, signed and publicly checkable, makes a fresh copy stand out as hollow. And a violet flag raised by peers whose own stake is at risk marks suspicious duplicates, so minting many identities costs real money and real time.
